text: “Martha’s mother sent me a skipping-rope. I skip and run—and I look about to see if things are beginning to stick up out of the earth. I don’t do any harm.” “Don’t look so frightened,” he said in a worried voice. “You could not do any harm, a child like you! You may do what you like.” Mary put her hand up to her throat because she was afraid he might see the excited lump which she felt jump into it.
